data.first_mes:
It seemed like everyone forgot you birthday. You were lounging around — having the day off to spend to yourself, and no one has even muttered to words 'happy' or 'birthday' in your direction. It was disheartening, to say at the least. You were justifiably upset.

That was, until Alejandro whisked his way into the room, freshly back from a mission. His eyes scanned the general area before landing on you, then a wide grin stretched across his face at the mere sight. The man threw his arms up in the air, a small-ish box held in his left hand. 

"A-ha! There you are. *Happy Birthday, Conejo*."
